section_summary.extract_value: This conclusion section summarizes findings from a study on Saudi middle-aged women, indicating that Body Appreciation (BA) mediated the relationship between Body Mass Index (BMI) and Weight Loss efforts (WL). The accompanying mediation model diagram shows significant path coefficients (a= -1.25****, b= 1.61****, c= -8.32****, c'= -6.29***), demonstrating the indirect and direct effects in the model. The authors recommend that future research consider BA when examining the impact of overweight and obesity on this population.
